잠언-28-4.title: 잠언 28장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-4.exegesis: 3. A poor man, &c.-- Such, in power, exact more severely, and so leave subjects bare.
잠언-28-4.theologicalNote: 3. A poor man, &c.-- Such, in power, exact more severely, and so leave subjects bare.

잠언-28-5.title: 잠언 28장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-5.exegesis: 4. They that forsake ... wicked-- Wrongdoers encourage one another.
잠언-28-5.theologicalNote: 4. They that forsake ... wicked-- Wrongdoers encourage one another.

잠언-28-6.title: 잠언 28장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-6.exegesis: 5. (Compare Joh 7:17 ). Ignorance of moral truth is due to unwillingness to know it.
잠언-28-6.theologicalNote: 5. (Compare Joh 7:17 ). Ignorance of moral truth is due to unwillingness to know it.

잠언-28-7.title: 잠언 28장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-7.exegesis: 6. (Compare Pr 10:6 ). Riches cannot compensate for sin, nor the want of them affect integrity.
잠언-28-7.theologicalNote: 6. (Compare Pr 10:6 ). Riches cannot compensate for sin, nor the want of them affect integrity.

잠언-28-9.title: 잠언 28장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-9.exegesis: 8. usury ... unjust gain-- (Compare Margin). The two terms, meaning nearly the same, may denote excessive interest. God's providence directs the proper use of wealth.
잠언-28-9.theologicalNote: 8. usury ... unjust gain-- (Compare Margin). The two terms, meaning nearly the same, may denote excessive interest. God's providence directs the proper use of wealth.

잠언-28-10.title: 잠언 28장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-10.exegesis: 9. (Compare Pr 15:8 ; 21:27 ). hearing-- that is, obeying. God requires sincere worshippers ( Psa 66:18 ; Joh 4:24 ).
잠언-28-10.theologicalNote: 9. (Compare Pr 15:8 ; 21:27 ). hearing-- that is, obeying. God requires sincere worshippers ( Psa 66:18 ; Joh 4:24 ).

잠언-28-12.title: 잠언 28장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-12.exegesis: 11. A poor but wise man can discover (and expose) the rich and self-conceited.
잠언-28-12.theologicalNote: 11. A poor but wise man can discover (and expose) the rich and self-conceited.

잠언-28-13.title: 잠언 28장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-13.exegesis: 12. great glory-- or, cause for it to a people, for the righteous rejoice in good, and righteousness exalts a nation ( Pr 14:34 ). a man ... hidden-- that is, the good retire, or all kinds try to escape a wicked rule.
잠언-28-13.theologicalNote: 12. great glory-- or, cause for it to a people, for the righteous rejoice in good, and righteousness exalts a nation ( Pr 14:34 ). a man ... hidden-- that is, the good retire, or all kinds try to escape a wicked rule.

잠언-28-14.title: 잠언 28장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-14.exegesis: 13. (Compare Psa 32:3-5 ). Concealment of sin delivers none from God's wrath, but He shows mercy to the humble penitent ( Psa 51:4 ).
잠언-28-14.theologicalNote: 13. (Compare Psa 32:3-5 ). Concealment of sin delivers none from God's wrath, but He shows mercy to the humble penitent ( Psa 51:4 ).

잠언-28-15.title: 잠언 28장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-15.exegesis: 14. feareth-- that is, God, and so repents. hardeneth his heart-- makes himself insensible to sin, and so will not repent ( Pr 14:16 ; 29:1 ).
잠언-28-15.theologicalNote: 14. feareth-- that is, God, and so repents. hardeneth his heart-- makes himself insensible to sin, and so will not repent ( Pr 14:16 ; 29:1 ).

잠언-28-16.title: 잠언 28장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-16.exegesis: 15. The rapacity and cruelty of such beasts well represent some wicked men (compare Psa 7:2 ; 17:12 ).
잠언-28-16.theologicalNote: 15. The rapacity and cruelty of such beasts well represent some wicked men (compare Psa 7:2 ; 17:12 ).

잠언-28-17.title: 잠언 28장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-17.exegesis: 16. The prince ... understanding-- that is, He does not perceive that oppression jeopards his success. Covetousness often produces oppression, hence the contrast.
잠언-28-17.theologicalNote: 16. The prince ... understanding-- that is, He does not perceive that oppression jeopards his success. Covetousness often produces oppression, hence the contrast.

잠언-28-18.title: 잠언 28장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-18.exegesis: 17. doeth violence ... blood, &c.-- or, that is oppressed by the blood of life ( Ge 9:6 ), which he has taken. to the pit-- the grave or destruction ( Pr 1:12 ; Job 33:18-24 ; Psa 143:7 ). stay him-- sustain or deliver him.
잠언-28-18.theologicalNote: 17. doeth violence ... blood, &c.-- or, that is oppressed by the blood of life ( Ge 9:6 ), which he has taken. to the pit-- the grave or destruction ( Pr 1:12 ; Job 33:18-24 ; Psa 143:7 ). stay him-- sustain or deliver him.

잠언-28-19.title: 잠언 28장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-19.exegesis: 18. (Compare Pr 10:9 ; 17:20 ). Double dealing is eventually fatal.
잠언-28-19.theologicalNote: 18. (Compare Pr 10:9 ; 17:20 ). Double dealing is eventually fatal.

잠언-28-20.title: 잠언 28장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-20.exegesis: 19. (Compare Pr 10:4 ; 20:4 ). vain persons-- idle, useless drones, implying that they are also wicked ( Pr 12:11 ; Psa 26:4 ).
잠언-28-20.theologicalNote: 19. (Compare Pr 10:4 ; 20:4 ). vain persons-- idle, useless drones, implying that they are also wicked ( Pr 12:11 ; Psa 26:4 ).

잠언-28-21.title: 잠언 28장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-21.exegesis: 20. maketh haste ... rich-- implying deceit or fraud ( Pr 20:21 ), and so opposed to "faithful" or reliable.
잠언-28-21.theologicalNote: 20. maketh haste ... rich-- implying deceit or fraud ( Pr 20:21 ), and so opposed to "faithful" or reliable.

잠언-28-22.title: 잠언 28장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-22.exegesis: 21. respect of persons-- ( Pr 24:23 ). Such are led to evil by the slightest motive.
잠언-28-22.theologicalNote: 21. respect of persons-- ( Pr 24:23 ). Such are led to evil by the slightest motive.

잠언-28-23.title: 잠언 28장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-28-23.exegesis: 22. (Compare Pr 28:20 ). evil eye-- in the general sense of Pr 23:6 , here more specific for covetousness (compare Pr 22:9 ; Mt 20:15 ). poverty ... him-- by God's providence.
잠언-28-23.theologicalNote: 22. (Compare Pr 28:20 ). evil eye-- in the general sense of Pr 23:6 , here more specific for covetousness (compare Pr 22:9 ; Mt 20:15 ). poverty ... him-- by God's providence.

잠언-28-24.title: 잠언 28장 24절 역사문법적 주해

잠언-30-2.title: 잠언 30장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-30-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 30 Pr 30:1-33 . 1. This is the title of this chapter (see Introduction). the prophecy-- literally, "the burden" (compare Is 13:1 ; Zec 9:1 ), used for any divine instruction; not necessarily a prediction, which was only a kind of prophecy ( 1Ch 15:27 , "a song"). Prophets were inspired men, who spoke for God to man, or for man to God ( Ge 20:7 ; Ex 7:14 , 15, 16 ). Such, also, were the New Testament prophets. In a general sense, Gad, Nathan, and others were such, who were divine teachers, though we do not learn that they ever predicted. the man spake-- literally, "the saying of the man"; an expression used to denote any solemn and important announcement (compare 2Sa 23:1 ; Psa 36:1 ; 110:1 ; Is 1:24 , &c.). Ithiel and Ucal were perhaps pupils.

잠언-30-3.title: 잠언 30장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-30-3.exegesis: 2-4. brutish-- stupid, a strong term to denote his lowly self-estimation; or he may speak of such as his natural condition, as contrasted with God's all-seeing comprehensive knowledge and almighty power. The questions of this clause emphatically deny the attributes mentioned to be those of any creature, thus impressively strengthening the implied reference of the former to God (compare De 30:12-14 ; Is 40:12 ; Ep 4:8 ).

잠언-30-25.title: 잠언 30장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-30-25.exegesis: 24-31. These verses provide two classes of apt illustrations of various aspects of the moral world, which the reader is left to apply. By the first ( Pr 30:25-28 ), diligence and providence are commended; the success of these insignificant animals being due to their instinctive sagacity and activity, rather than strength. The other class ( Pr 30:30 , 31 ) provides similes for whatever is majestic or comely, uniting efficiency with gracefulness.

잠언-31-4.title: 잠언 31장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-31-4.exegesis: 3-9. 잠언-31-11.title: 잠언 31장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-31-11.exegesis: 10-31. This exquisite picture of a truly lovely wife is conceived and drawn in accordance with the customs of Eastern nations, but its moral teachings suit all climes. In Hebrew the verses begin with the letters of the Hebrew alphabet in order (compare Introduction to Poetical Books). Who ... woman-- The question implies that such are rare, though not entirely wanting (compare Pr 18:22 ; 19:14 ). virtuous-- literally, "of strength," that is, moral courage (compare Pr 12:4 ; Ru 3:11 ). her price, &c.-- (compare Pr 3:15 ).
